g.text: How the Architecture Works, How Trade-offs Are Encoded, & What We Just Rebuilt
The Core Rule: Zero post-hoc guessing · Immutable line provenance · External deterministic gates · Intentional authorial trade-offs
Every session recording is transcribed and locked with immutable IDs:
Tier B: Actions, Spells & GM Intent
Dice math stripped, but physical manifestation novelized
Wi-Fi drops, pizza orders, calendar banter
Trade-offs must live in configuration files, never lost in chat:
Bans "dravin incanted", "cast chill touch", Hollywood heist tropes
Demands physical tokens: spectacles, handrail twitch, linoleum
Every scene logs what was adapted, why, and narrative impact
Prevents single-prompt LLM cognitive collapse by separating perspective duties before drafting:
STAGE 4: THE INFALLIBLE MECHANICAL GATES (ZERO SELF-GRADING)
Automated Python Suite: Hard Stops on Any Architectural Violation
Subagents write and debate, but NEVER evaluate themselves. Deterministic scripts guard every invariant:
Blocks hollow skips & unanchored vehicle realia
No premature lore or undeclared characters
Zero regex guessing; dialogue speaker lock
🚀 Orchestrator: run_publishing_pipeline.py s1 s2 s3 s4 s5
Executes all 7 gates in sequence, compiles EPUBs, and renders the Dual-Track Scorecard. Halts on first failure.
Two Purpose-Built Cuts for Two Different Audiences
Honest evaluation: strict table fidelity for research vs fluid velocity for literature:
Target: Audiobook, mobile interactive reader, forensic canon.
Target: Traditional consumer fantasy novel reading experience.
Itemized Liberties: Only licensed structural departures
CASE STUDY: WHAT WE JUST DID IN SESSION 1 & THE PIPELINE FIXES
The Tabletop Issue: Nick declared standard spells, but Dravin is an unawakened academic.
The Fix: Stripped wizard chanting; staged magic as accidental reflexes:
• Chill Touch: Defensive recoil freezing linoleum puddles
• Toll the Dead: Startled handrail finger-twitch with fizzled chime
• Eyes of Night & Spare the Dying: Spectacle lens glare & chest compressions
The Defect: Legacy drafting duplicated whole scenes back-to-back.
The Fix: Audited chronologically from Scene 1 forward:
• Ch 2 & 3: Purged double-rift opening & duplicate Alfie spawn
• Ch 4 & 6: Unified Alfie awakening & Eusacles morningstar strikes
• Ch 12: Restored Theodore's full prompt: "What edit killed you?"
3. Re-Running the Pipeline Caught Real Hidden Bugs
Running the full suite across all 5 sessions caught 2 silent regressions:
• S4 Cadence Failure: Participial clauses exceeded 1.13/500w.
Converted 4 clauses into active past-tense declarative sentences (0.70/500w).
• S3/S4 Line Provenance: Shifting block counts broke legacy overrides.
Purged brittle block overrides; mapped L0412 (Ally) & L1142/L1153 (Naomi).
We never test scenes in isolation or hide behind chat surgery:
• Every change compiles EPUBs and regenerates web manifests.
• Every scene adaptation must be recorded in the intent contract.
• All 5 sessions (S1–S5) run through the gate runner on every update.
Result: 100% Parity, 0 Regressions, Zero Faux Novelty
